title: Enter the room code
body: Ask the host for the 6 digits, or scan their QR code with your camera.

errors.notFound: No open room with this code. Check the digits with the host.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Ask the host for the link, or try again in a few minutes.
errors.starting: The game is starting. Try again in a moment.
errors.inFinale: They're voting on the final pick right now. Catch the next game.
errors.removed: The host removed you from this room.
errors.locked: This room is locked. Ask the host to unlock it.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the room. Check your connection.
